issues.issue: Whether the claimants are citizens of Albania (identity)
issues.applicant_position: Claimants are Albanian citizens, shown by their testimony and Albanian passports.
issues.result_quote: The panel finds that the claimants' identity as citizens of Albania is established on the basis of their testimony and Albanian passports.

issues.issue: Whether the principal claimant bought the disputed land informally
issues.applicant_position: Principal claimant bought the land informally from the XXXX family in 2000; no paperwork was needed.
issues.result_quote: The panel therefore finds that the principal claimant did informally purchase the land

issues.issue: Whether the claimants were targeted by the land-dispute agent of persecution in Albania
issues.applicant_position: Agent and a policeman assaulted him in 2001 and the agent later burned the family home; the claimants fear him.
issues.result_quote: The panel finds on a balance of probabilities that the claimants have not established that XXXX XXXX harmed or sought to harm the claimants

issues.issue: Whether the claimants' failure to claim refugee protection in Greece undermines their claim
issues.applicant_position: They had no status in Greece and feared being sent back to Albania, so did not claim.
issues.result_quote: the failure to have made refugee protection claims in Greece, for which a reasonable explanation was not provided, is further indicative

issues.issue: Whether the brother's death and the 2013 kidnapping attempt in Greece were by the agent or his associates
issues.applicant_position: The brother was killed and the son targeted in Greece by the agent of persecution or his associates.
issues.result_quote: that there is no ongoing vendetta by XXXX XXXX and the claims made by the claimants are not credible

issues.issue: Whether the 2016 attack on the principal claimant's mother shows an ongoing threat
issues.applicant_position: Unknown men sent by the agent attacked the mother in 2016 and threatened the principal claimant.
issues.result_quote: The panel therefore finds that XXXX XXXX account of the attack is not credible
